text:
Alice Nguyen: 👋 heads up — customer (acme-inc) seeing a spike of 429s during short bursts after a recent billing plan change. They say their client SDK keeps retrying and they observe duplicate downstream events in their system. Attached logs show 429 with reason "quota_exhausted" and an intermittent 402 earlier. They claim they are sending `Idempotency-Key` but duplicates still happen.

Carla M: we started seeing it yesterday after scaling traffic up for a promo. Examples: lots of quick POSTs to /v1/generate, about 10 reqs in <2s. Some succeed, some 429. The SDK retries and eventually returns success for a different request id, so we have two processed ops on our side.

Alice Nguyen: @Ben can you take a look at whether our rate limiter + billing transition could be returning 429s without honoring idempotency semantics? They included SDK request headers in logs (sanitized):

```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Idempotency-Key: 87f3a1c2-39b2-4f6d-ae77
User-Agent: redwood-sdk-js/0.9.2
```

DeployBot: notice: rollout/redwood-rate-limiter-v2 completed 2024-11-01T14:32:00Z :rocket:

Ben Torres: thanks. two quick checks: 1) SDK version (looks like 0.9.2 per header) — there was a known retry behavior change around then. 2) Are they using client-side idempotency for each logical op or letting the SDK auto-generate?

Carla M: we let the SDK auto-generate keys — we didn't set our own. We assumed auto-key + idempotency header would be present on retries.

Dave (SDK): quick summary from SDK side — in 0.9.x we changed default retry to aggressive exponential backoff with 5 max attempts for 429/5xx. There was also a bug in 0.9.2 where the `Idempotency-Key` header was not copied to internal retry attempts for some streaming/partial-chunked flows. That could explain duplicates if the initial request actually got through but a retry (without key) resulted in a second successful op on our backend. We're shipping a patch in 0.9.3.

Ben Torres: that aligns with the pattern. If the backend enforces dedup via `Idempotency-Key` header, missing it on retry bypasses dedup. Also note quota_exhausted 429s may be returned without `Retry-After` in some internal modes; the client then retries immediately. We should check rate-limiter logs to see if we returned 429 with `x-rw-quota-window` header or `Retry-After`.

Erin - Billing: from billing side — when accounts change plan we run a grace-mode: short window where quota enforcement can be stricter until the new limits are fully reconciled. During that reconciliation we do return 429s referencing quota, but dedup should still be enforced server-side. If requests come in without idempotency header we can't dedup. Billing will also emit `payment_required` (402) only in edge cases.

Alice Nguyen: repro plan to confirm: 1) reproduce spikes with SDK 0.9.2 auto-keying and observe whether retries strip `Idempotency-Key`. 2) repeat with explicit `Idempotency-Key` set by caller. 3) repeat with patched SDK 0.9.3. That should prove root cause.

Carla M: can you share the minimal curl to repro? We can run it from our staging.

Dave (SDK): repro curl to simulate immediate retries (this mimic auto-retry without key copy bug):

```
# simulate a single logical op, SDK would normally attach Idempotency-Key
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}'
```

To explicitly test idempotency behavior:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: my-test-key-123" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}'
```

If you see the first request succeed and a subsequent retry also succeed but with a different `operation_id`, then server-side dedup didn't see the key.

Ben Torres: suggested SDK config for mitigation until patch: set `max_retries=2`, `base_backoff=300ms`, `max_backoff=2s`, and prefer jitter (full jitter). Also recommend callers set their own `Idempotency-Key` for critical ops. Example pseudo-config: `client = RedwoodClient({maxRetries:2, backoffStrategy:"full_jitter"})`

Erin - Billing: we'll also add an extra header on 429s during the plan reconciliation window: `X-RW-Quota-Phase: reconciling` and include `Retry-After` when applicable. Ops will add tracing to show whether idempotency key was present when the backend processed the first success.

Carla M: ok we'll run repro in staging with our traffic pattern and test SDK pinned to 0.9.2, then with explicit `Idempotency-Key`, then with 0.9.3 when available. Any quick server-side check I can ask you to run to confirm dedup?

Alice Nguyen: Ben / Erin — can you confirm where to look in logs for whether idempotency header was seen on the request that the service recorded as processed? If it's in request logs we can correlate by `request_id`.

Ben Torres: yes — check `ingress-reqs` logs for `idempotency_key` field and `operation_status`. I'll pull a short query and paste below.

(10m later) Ben Torres: query result: for Carla's sample timeframe I see 27 requests, 7 returned 429, and 3 pairs where first request had `idempotency_key` present but the retry attempt recorded a different `request_id` with no key. Looks exactly like the SDK copy bug.

Dave (SDK): created PR #2345 to fix header copy for retries in 0.9.3. Workaround for customers: set `Idempotency-Key` explicitly or pin SDK to 0.8.x if you need immediate stability. We'll cut a patch release next hour.

Erin - Billing: I've flagged acme-inc for a short manual grace and turned on extra logging for their account during reconciliation window. No billing duplicates expected from our side but I will monitor.

Carla M: thanks all — running repro now. I'll post results here.

Alice Nguyen: action items: (1) Dave ship 0.9.3 patch ASAP, (2) Ben add a short dashboard to show requests with missing idempotency on retries, (3) Erin monitor acme-inc, (4) Carla run repro and report. If Carla still sees duplicates after patch we'll escalate to eng-runtime.

Carla M: quick update — staging repro shows duplicates when relying on SDK auto-key in 0.9.2. Explicit `Idempotency-Key` fixed it. Thanks for the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

Alice Nguyen: great — closing loop after 0.9.3 is out. If anyone wants the repro script I used, ping me and I'll drop it here.
